step_by_step_reasoning: The architecture diagram depicts an end-to-end IoT platform from L&T Technology Services connecting edge devices to the AWS cloud for real-time and batch analytics, along with model retraining. 1. Edge Layer: BIQSens edge devices, Greengrass, and Lambda at the edge process plant equipment data (motors, HVACs) and send it to AWS IoT Core. 2. Cloud Ingestion & Analytics: AWS IoT Core uses IoT Rules to route data to both Kinesis Streams (for real-time streaming) and AWS IoT Analytics (for batch statistical process control). 3. Real-Time & Batch Outputs: Kinesis Streams feeds data to Kinesis Analytics for real-time anomaly detection, writes data/audit logs to S3, and sends alerts/notifications to the User. IoT Analytics delivers data to QuickSight for visualization and directly notifies the User. 4. Continuous Model Improvement: S3 acts as a data lake feeding historical operational data into SageMaker for retraining ML models. The updated models are subsequently redeployed back to Lambda at the edge.

graph.name: LT Technology Services Edge-to-Cloud Predictive Maintenance Platform
graph.notes: End-to-end IoT architecture showing data ingestion from edge devices through AWS IoT Core, real-time analytics with Kinesis, batch analytics with IoT Analytics and QuickSight, and model retraining via S3 and SageMaker deployed back to edge Lambda functions.

nodes.name: Lambda
nodes.notes: Runs edge compute functions on Greengrass and executes deployed predictive ML models.

nodes.name: Greengrass
nodes.notes: Connects plant machinery and smart building equipment at the edge to AWS IoT Core.

nodes.name: BIQSens
nodes.notes: Edge component collecting sensor metrics from plant motors, pumps, and HVAC systems.

nodes.name: IoT Core
nodes.notes: Central AWS IoT Hub that uses IoT Rules to filter and route telemetry data to analytics channels.

nodes.name: Kinesis Streams
nodes.notes: Streams real-time equipment data for streaming analytics and data lake persistence.

nodes.name: Kinesis Analytics
nodes.notes: Performs real-time analytics and condition-based monitoring to predict failures.

nodes.name: IoT Analytics
nodes.notes: Performs batch analysis and runs statistical process control (SPC) functions.

nodes.name: QuickSight
nodes.notes: Visualizes batch analytics, trend metrics, and threshold breach reports.

nodes.name: S3
nodes.notes: Data lake store holding audit logs, raw datasets, and historical telemetry for model training.

nodes.name: SageMaker
nodes.notes: Trains machine learning models to continuously improve anomaly detection accuracy.

nodes.name: User
nodes.notes: End user / operator receiving real-time failure alerts, monitoring dashboards, and batch analytics.

edges.notes: Edge Lambda sends processed equipment telemetry to IoT Core.
Greengrass connects plant machinery metrics directly to IoT Core.
BIQSens edge system sends sensor data to AWS IoT Core.
IoT Rules route real-time streaming data into Kinesis Streams.
IoT Rules route data into IoT Analytics for batch analysis.
Kinesis Streams writes dataset records and audit logs into S3 buckets.
Kinesis Streams feeds real-time telemetry to Kinesis Analytics for anomaly detection.
Kinesis Streams triggers real-time alerts to notify end users of threshold breaches.
IoT Analytics sends processed batch analytics to QuickSight for visual reporting.
IoT Analytics delivers batch statistical insights and notifications to the end user.
SageMaker uses S3 data lake datasets to train predictive maintenance models.
SageMaker deploys updated, highly accurate ML models back to Lambda at the edge.
